charts.title: Qwen3.8-27B on one RTX 3090: against the best published figures
charts.subtitle: ashalliants/ninfer-3090 against the fastest figure any other engine publishes for this model on one RTX 3090, per workload. Above 1.0x means ours is faster. Every other figure is the author's own, from a different machine, quant and power limit, so read the ratios as indicative.
charts.desc: Qwen3.8-27B on one RTX 3090, ashalliants/ninfer-3090 against the best published figures. Chat, one request, vs syv-ai HyperQwen: 1.02x decode (133.2 vs 131.2), 1.22x prefill. Code vs open-jet: 1.39x (194.6 vs 140). No drafts vs open-jet: 1.11x (47.7 vs 42.9). 98K-token context vs open-jet: 0.98x (93.9 vs 95.9). Eight requests at once vs syv-ai: 1.03x (421.4 vs 407.3).

panels.title: Decode, one request (tok/s)
panels.note: Greedy, thinking off. "File rewrite" asks for a supplied file back with small edits, so most of the answer is copied from the prompt; syv-ai's 381 is its figure for answers that quote the prompt, at 25K context.

panels.title: Several requests at once, aggregate decode (tok/s)
panels.note: syv-ai's eight prompts, 1,024 tokens each, greedy. NInfer serves at most eight requests at once; syv-ai's batch mode reports about 1,035 tok/s at 64.

panels.title: Prefill (tok/s)
panels.note: Server-side prefill time of one fresh prompt, no prefix reused. The 10K report does not name its engine (probably syv-ai's).

notes: Where we lose: at 98K tokens of context open-jet reports 95.9 tok/s against our 93.9 (0.98x). syv-ai's batch mode reports about 1,035 tok/s at 64 requests; NInfer is built for one to eight.

Quants differ: ours is this fork's Q4/Q5 group-quant mix (17.0 GiB), syv-ai runs W4A16 AutoRound with int8 Marlin layers, open-jet Unsloth's Q4_K_M. Conditions and sources for every figure: docs/performance.md, "Qwen3.8-27B against the best published RTX 3090 figures".
